en.t: For the filming, Aikawa was still serving as director.

units.source_text: 友子扮演一个艺伎，是女主角的妹妹，她坐在绯牡丹花样的床铺上写情书。

en.t: Tomoko played a geisha, the younger sister of the heroine, sitting on bedding patterned with scarlet peonies as she wrote a love letter.

units.source_text: 其他艺伎和见习艺伎在里屋围圈而坐，等待接活儿。

en.t: The other geisha and apprentice geisha sat in a circle in the back room, waiting to be called for work.

units.source_text: 新闻片的电影记者和布景画家一边品评着这些女演员的优劣，一边站在布景之外。

en.t: The newsreel cameraman and the set painter stood outside the set, commenting on the merits and flaws of these actresses.
